newsitem.title: KENYA: CRICKET-SRI LANKA BAT FIRST AGAINST KENYA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SRI LANKA BAT FIRST AGAINST KENYA.

text.p: World Cup champions Sri Lanka won the toss and put hosts Kenya in to bat first in the opening one-day game of the Kenyan Centenary four-nation cricket tournament at the Nairobi Gymkhana Club on Saturday.

Sri Lanka: Sanath Jayasuriya, Romesh Kaluwitharana, Asanka Gurusinha, Aravinda de Silva, Arjuna Ranatunga (captain), Hashan Tillekeratne, Upul Chandana, Kumar Dharmasena, Sanjeewa de Silva, Chaminda Vaas, Muttiah Muralitheran.
Kenya: Dipak Chudasama, Kennedy Otieno, Sandip Gupta, Steve Tikolo, Maurice Odumbe (captain), Edward Odumbe, Hitesh Modi, Asif Karim, Martin Owiti, Rajab Ali, Thomas Odoyo.
